preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 1000 for N in Ns)

preconditions.description: The sum of all Ns does not exceed 1000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines[i].split()) == Ns[i] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N numbers corresponding to the permutation.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= Ns[i] for x in output_lines[i].split()) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each number in the output permutation is between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(output_lines[i].split())) == Ns[i] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each permutation contains unique numbers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(median(P_i) != median(P_i_plus_1) for i in range(Ns[i] - 1) for P_i in [sorted(output_lines[i].split()[:i+1])] for P_i_plus_1 in [sorted(output_lines[i].split()[:i+2])])
postconditions.description: No two adjacent medians in the permutation are equal.
